'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Jan Westergard DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / Cat And Mouse]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
